## Appearance

Anne is a tall, slim girl with a pointed, pale face, a thin body, and seven freckles on her nose. She has luminous, serious gray eyes and glossy, tumbled red hair—also referred to as auburn or [Titian](../character/titian.md)—which she wears in long braids. Friends describe her appearance as stylish, noting her expressive eyes and the pale, changing color of her cheeks.

## Personality

Anne is an imaginative, smart, and obedient individual who possesses a talent for reciting, though she can also be heedless and impulsive. Passionately loyal, she is a staunch [Conservative](../codex/factions.md#conservative) in memory of [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) and holds a deep fondness for children. Driven by a desire to enrich the world by adding beauty to life, she is also intensely dedicated to her studies, striving to excel in examinations for the sake of [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and resolving to win the Avery scholarship through hard work.

## History

Anne grew up as an orphaned girl who suffered a lonely, starved childhood, moving between homes before being taken in by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Though initially brought to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) by mistake, she won over the [Cuthberts](../codex/factions.md#cuthberts), who decided to adopt her and give her a proper home. Anne's early years at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) were marked by dramatic mishaps, strong rivalries, and deep friendships, including a fierce academic feud with classmate [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and a lifelong bond with [Diana Barry](../character/di.md). She proved her resourcefulness when she saved Diana's sister [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) from croup, winning back the favor of Diana's family after a prior misunderstanding. Supported by [Matthew](../character/matthew.md), who gave her her first stylish dress with puffed sleeves, Anne excelled in her studies and established a story club with her friends. She eventually tied for first place on the [Island](../codex/places.md#island) [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations alongside [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and earned the prestigious Avery scholarship at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). Tragically, [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) died from a sudden heart attack shortly after her graduation, leaving Anne to process deep grief alongside [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Anne sacrificed her scholarship to teach locally at [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) School so she could stay with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and she later helped care for two orphaned twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md), whom [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) took in. During her time as a teacher, Anne inadvertently sold her neighbor's cow by mistake, but she smoothed over the conflict with a peace offering and earned his good will. She also formed a close friendship with her pupil [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) and played a pivotal role in reuniting Paul's father with her eccentric friend, Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). When Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) moved into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) following her husband's death, Anne was able to resign her teaching post to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college).

## Quotes

> "Well, that is another hope gone. ‘My life is a perfect graveyard of buried hopes.’ That’s a sentence I read in a book once, and I say it over to comfort myself whenever I’m disappointed in anything."
>
> — Anne — [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P3](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0003)

> “Oh, what I know about myself isn’t really worth telling,” said Anne eagerly. “If you’ll only let me tell you what I imagine about myself you’ll think it ever so much more interesting.”
>
> — Anne — [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P9](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0009)

> “I was afraid it might be Mrs. Spencer’s place,” said Anne mournfully. “I don’t want to get there. Somehow, it will seem like the end of everything.”
>
> — Anne — [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P26](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0026)

> “I—I saw it this afternoon when you were away at the Aid Society,” said Anne, a little slowly. “I was passing your door when I saw it on the cushion, so I went in to look at it.”
>
> — Anne — [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P2](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0002)

> “I did put it back,” said Anne quickly—pertly, Marilla thought. “I don’t just remember whether I stuck it on the pincushion or laid it in the china tray. But I’m perfectly certain I put it back.”
>
> — Anne — [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P8](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0008)

## Relationships

### [Allan](../character/allan.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/allan--anne.md)

Anne formed an immediate bond with Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md), viewing her as a kindred spirit and looking up to her as a model. Their initial social encounter at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) was marked by embarrassment when Anne accidentally flavored Mrs. Allan's layer cake with liniment, but Mrs. Allan's gentle and comforting reaction cemented Anne's deep affection for her.

- Friend of — kindred spirits and minister's wife  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P6](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0006)</sub>

### [Bertha Shirley](../character/bertha-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--bertha-shirley.md)

[Bertha Shirley](../character/bertha-shirley.md) was Anne's mother who died when Anne was a baby. While recounting her background as an orphan, Anne recalled her mother's early death, which led to Anne being passed between families and living in an asylum before arriving at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).
